verdict_rationale: All safety gates PASS. All core implementation taskcards (TC-02 through TC-12) complete with tests. 77 metrics tests + 966 full regression pass. Live test POST succeeded. Gaps are all LOW severity and expected by the plan design (other-command wiring deferred, production gated behind human approval, sheet verification requires human). Verdict is PARTIAL_WITH_GAPS rather than VERIFIED_COMPLETE solely because: (1) Google Sheet cannot be independently verified from agent, (2) only run command instrumented, (3) dry-run E2E not reproduced. None of these represent safety or correctness issues.
recommendation: Implementation is safe and functional for the run command. Human should: (1) visually confirm test row in Google Sheet, (2) approve or defer production enablement (TC-14), (3) plan next sprint to wire remaining commands when count formulas are verified.
